as_told.title: Fred Crisman, JFK 'three tramps' and the Maury Island incident

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that after President John F. Kennedy was shot in Dallas, Texas, in 1963, three men who looked like hobos were arrested, and that some people think one of them was a man named Fred Crisman. Michels adds that Crisman was also involved in the Maury Island incident of 1947, a reported UFO episode from around the time a man named Kenneth Arnold said he saw his UFO. A researcher and author, Peter Levenda, says he can back this up and suggests another man, E. Howard Hunt, may have been one of the three as well. If true, it would tie early UFO history directly to the Kennedy assassination.
